intro: Start with a small sample of your own conversations, with sources and backups.
title: Make your knowledge useful
categories: SelfOS organizes project context, personal facts, preferences, reusable lessons and history. Every result keeps its sources; imports create recoverable backups.
no_automatic_import: Opening or resuming this guide never starts an import. Choose sources and explicitly start a bounded sample.
source_help: Select Claude Code or Codex conversation folders, or custom folders containing their JSONL exports. One absolute directory per line.
exclusion_help: One absolute path per line, inside a selected folder. Exclusions also filter cached model context; local history is retained.
model_help: Choose an Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible model and your proxy in Settings. Keys remain in the existing local model configuration.
test_budget: Save and test connection makes one configured-model request. Navigation through this guide makes none.
privacy: The excerpts below and source-supported cached project context go to your configured model only after Start sample. This preview stays local.
limits: Default: at most 2 files (8 MiB each), 20 messages per session, 2 compact parts, and 12 total requests including retries and reviews. Enumeration is limited to 2,000 entries.
new_allowance: New preview: grant another 12 requests (24 for the larger tier)
publication_help: Saved checkpoints are recoverable progress. Results appear in the library after publication. Stop keeps checkpoints; resume keeps the same remaining allowance.
more_help: Process more opens a new preview: at most 4 files, 40 messages per session, 4 parts and 24 total requests. It does not start automatically.
missing: Unavailable; select a custom folder below
clipped: This is a clipped sample. Some files or messages were omitted due to the limits. Original files are unchanged.
complete_preview: All messages selected for this sample are shown below.
no_preview: Build a local preview before starting.
result_counts: Published: {projects} projects, {facts} facts, {preferences} preferences, {lessons} lessons. Saved checkpoints: {saved}.
loading: Loading… You can close this guide at any time.
ready: Ready. Model processing starts only when you click Start sample.
unavailable: Setup state is unavailable. Check local metadata and reopen Settings; existing knowledge is preserved.
invalid: Check absolute source paths and exclusions. Changed sources or an exhausted allowance require a new preview.
import_active: Stop or finish the active import before changing setup or creating another preview.
warning_oversize: Skipped a file larger than 8 MiB
warning_symlink: Skipped a symbolic link or junction
warning_unavailable: A source folder could not be read
warning_file_limit: Only the newest eligible files within this sample limit were selected
